email.body1:
Jansen, saw Neuron7 unveil the Complete Service Intelligence Stack off the back of 300% ARR growth and your $44M Series B.

Growth and a new platform launch usually means more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can touch before the new targets ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Neuron7 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jansen, quick follow-up for Neuron7.

Post-Series B, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Neuron7 needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jansen, last bit of proof for Neuron7.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Neuron7's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jansen, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise growth stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Neuron7 either way.
